source_snapshot.purpose_facts: The row names a PCIe correctable Bad TLP RAS test on an unspecified NVIDIA CPU platform.
procedure_facts: Before-test text asks for recipe conformity and log clearing.
The complete during-test instruction is only `PCIE RAS Features - Bad TLP`.
After-test text asks for result/photo collection and unexpected-log review.
missing_source_information: Exact NVIDIA platform, PCIe hierarchy and OS/firmware AER ownership.
Authoritative Bad TLP stimulus/injector, execution location and command.
Target endpoint/port, receiver/reporting port and BDF mapping with coverage.
Expected correctable AER status/counter/source identity, timeout and link/device health.
Safety, traffic quiescence, recovery, restoration and pass/fail criteria.

original_test_intent.statement: Validate that an approved PCIe hierarchy on an unspecified NVIDIA CPU platform detects and reports a deliberately created Bad TLP as a correctable AER condition while preserving link, device and system function; the current row does not define how or where to generate it or how to accept it.
must_preserve: PCIe Bad TLP stimulus, not a generic PCIe error.
Correctable severity, not uncorrectable non-fatal or fatal.
NVIDIA CPU platform after exact product identification.
must_not_infer: That endpoint BDF, receiving port and AER reporting Root Port/RCEC are the same object.
That Bad LCRC is necessarily the intended Bad TLP stimulus mechanism.
That Linux `aer-inject`, ACPI EINJ, a vendor tool or an external protocol exerciser is intended.
One representative device, all slots or any iteration count.
That BERT or BMC SEL must report a runtime correctable AER event on every platform.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly identifies a label-only procedure plus TBD Criteria as a genuine blocker, requires topology/BDF mapping and authoritative NVIDIA artifacts, permits read-only baselines and prohibits a fabricated Bad TLP injection.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not explicitly separate the traffic endpoint/origin, receiving component and AER reporting Root Port/RCEC, may imply BERT/SEL are universal evidence, and does not state that correctable handling should preserve function without link/device reset unless the signed platform rule says otherwise.

related_records: Other PCIe LCRC, malformed-TLP, unsupported-request, endpoint and root-port cases cannot supply this Bad TLP row's target locus or injector by analogy.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The source fixes only Bad TLP and correctable severity. Its missing Criteria and label-only procedure prevent importing a stimulus, BDF or evidence path from another platform.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Maintain BLOCKED until the owner defines the actual Bad TLP stimulus and acceptance rule. Add an explicit per-hierarchy locus map, platform-specific AER ownership/evidence and correctable no-reset/link-health contract; allow only non-mutating topology and counter baselines beforehand.

conditions_present: Bad TLP, correctable severity, NVIDIA CPU PCIe RAS context, generic pre/post collection and 10/10-minute estimates are known.
missing: Exact platform/hierarchy, stimulus and execution location, tool, source/receiver/reporter mapping, target coverage, native evidence, timeout, no-reset/health gate, approvals and recovery.
provider: NVIDIA/ODM FAE supplies the platform PCIe RAS specification, supported Bad TLP generator and expected reporting locus.
Test owner defines hierarchy coverage, event/counter criteria and timeout.
Device/network/storage owners approve target isolation; lab owner provides dedicated SUT, console and recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory the PCIe tree, endpoint/bridge/Root Port/RCEC BDFs, link speed/width, drivers and firmware.
Read AER capabilities, control/status masks, OS-versus-firmware AER ownership and existing per-device counters without clearing them.
Export timestamped OS/BMC/firmware and device-health baselines and identify production, boot, storage, network or management dependencies.
prohibited_until_resolved: Traffic generation for fault stimulus, log/status clearing, AER mask/control changes, injector loading/configuration/writes, protocol-exerciser attachment, Bad TLP generation, reset/retrain, retry or PASS/FAIL claim.
closure_evidence: Signed Procedure and Criteria identify platform, stimulus, execution location and correctable acceptance.
A topology row binds traffic endpoint/origin, receiver, reporter and their BDFs with required coverage.
Expected status bit/counter/event, freshness, timeout, no-reset/link/device/system health, recovery and approvals pass fresh review.

revision_candidate.test_name: NVIDIA CPU PCIe Bad TLP Correctable Error - Definition Required
revision_candidate.purpose: After an authoritative recipe is supplied, generate one defined Bad TLP stimulus for each approved PCIe hierarchy target and verify a fresh target-correlated correctable AER indication at the signed reporting locus while link, device and system function remain healthy without an unexpected reset or retrain. The current row is not executable.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Unresolved. The owner must identify the NVIDIA CPU/product, system/stepping, firmware, BIOS/BMC, selected OS/kernel, AER ownership, PCIe generation/topology, endpoints and supported internal/vendor/external Bad TLP stimulus. Do not transfer a Grace, BlueField, GPU, switch or generic Linux recipe without exact applicability.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Unresolved hierarchy rows. Each future row must bind the traffic endpoint/origin, receiving component, AER reporting Root Port or RCEC, all relevant BDFs, link and device role, and required iterations. The source does not authorize one representative endpoint or all slots. Treat 10/10 minutes as estimates only.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Exact platform/topology and OS-versus-firmware AER ownership; authoritative NVIDIA/ODM/PCIe recipe; Bad TLP generator/interface/tool/exerciser version/hash and execution location; source/receiver/reporter BDF map and coverage; traffic precondition; exact stimulus; expected correctable status bit, source identity, native event and counter delta; mask/ratelimit/freshness/timeout; no-reset/retrain and link/device/service health; baseline/clear policy; isolation approvals; recovery/restoration.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: No Bad TLP command or stimulus is authorized while Criteria is TBD and the Procedure is only a label. Perform only non-mutating topology, AER-capability/ownership, counter and health discovery. After the owner supplies a full recipe, submit it for fresh V3 review; only that approved contract may define a bounded stimulus at one signed hierarchy row, evidence correlation, health verification, recovery and restoration.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Criteria and procedure replaced by a signed recipe; exact platform, topology, AER ownership, generator, target loci, coverage and evidence resolved; dedicated non-production SUT; affected traffic/device quiesced or controlled; stable link/device/system baseline; console/OOB and recovery proven; each configuration, clear, stimulus, reset/retrain, retry and restoration action authorized.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Before authorization: signed platform/tool/topology/stimulus/evidence/safety/recovery contract. A future reviewed run requires identities/hashes; source/receiver/reporter map; link/driver/firmware baseline; AER ownership, capability, mask/status/counter and clear audit; per-row exact stimulus/transcript; fresh correctable Bad TLP status/event and expected counter delta tied to the signed reporting locus within timeout; preserved link speed/width, device enumeration/function, traffic/service and system health; anomalies, recovery, restoration and engineer disposition. BMC/BERT evidence is required only if the platform recipe defines it.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Not yet defined. The signed NVIDIA/ODM platform recipe and applicable PCIe AER definition must name the reporting locus and exact evidence. Public Linux documentation establishes that correctable errors are logged/counted and ordinarily require no recovery action, but it neither selects a Bad TLP generator nor authorizes this case.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not infer BDFs or reporting locus, equate endpoint with Root Port/RCEC, substitute Bad LCRC for Bad TLP without recipe proof, choose `aer-inject`, EINJ, vendor tools or an exerciser by analogy, clear evidence, change AER masks/ownership, target production/boot/storage/network/management paths, inject, auto-loop/retry, reset/retrain or claim PASS/FAIL before fresh review. Stop on wrong severity/locus, uncorrectable escalation, link/device loss, reset/retrain, error storm or service impact.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: NVIDIA/ODM FAE and test owner approve the platform, generator, stimulus, topology loci, coverage and correctable event. Device/network/storage owners approve target isolation; lab owner approves SUT and recovery; a fresh reviewer approves the executable contract. Qualified staff authorize and supervise every later state change, external attachment, stimulus and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Before re-review, an Agent may only collect non-mutating topology, AER ownership/capability, counters and health baselines. Humans own recipe creation, physical/external exerciser work, target and traffic selection, state changes, stimulus authorization and recovery. The future contract defines any Agent execution boundary; engineering retains disposition.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No recovery action is authorized by the current row because no stimulus is authorized. Preserve accidental-change evidence, stop traffic if necessary and escalate. The replacement recipe must define wrong-locus/severity, link/device loss and host-failure recovery, mask/status restoration and final topology/link/device/service health.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Criteria remains TBD or procedure remains label-only; platform/topology/AER ownership/generator/source-receiver-reporter map/coverage/stimulus/evidence/timeout is unresolved; only generic or analogous documents exist; approval, dedicated SUT, traffic isolation, baseline, console, recovery, storage or restoration is missing; capability or BDF map mismatches the signed replacement; or any unreviewed clear, configuration, stimulus, reset/retrain or retry is proposed.

identified_defects: Criteria are entirely TBD and the Procedure is only a Bad TLP label.
No generator, execution location, target hierarchy, BDF mapping or coverage is defined.
V2 does not distinctly map origin/receiver/reporting port and treats several non-universal evidence sources generically.
No correctable status/counter, timeout, no-reset/link-health or recovery rule exists.
reason_for_change: Keep the genuine semantic blocker while making the Bad TLP-specific origin, receiver and AER reporting loci explicit and preventing a generic injector or non-universal BERT/SEL evidence from being substituted for missing criteria.

new_technical_evidence.title: PCI Express Advanced Error Reporting Driver Guide HOWTO
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Linux with native AER control and supported Root Port/RCEC
new_technical_evidence.supports: The AER driver attaches to Root Ports/RCECs, reports correctable errors as warnings, exposes counters and treats correctable errors as hardware-recovered without functional loss or recovery action.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The intended OS/firmware ownership, Bad TLP generator, reporting component and exact event fields for this NVIDIA platform are unknown.

new_technical_evidence.title: Linux Kernel ABI Testing Symbols - PCIe AER Statistics
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Linux devices exposing PCIe AER sysfs statistics
new_technical_evidence.supports: Per-device correctable statistics explicitly include Bad TLP, so a fresh counter delta can be an evidence component when supported.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Counter ownership and availability depend on the tested hierarchy and kernel; this does not define the stimulus.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-System RAS-00826-V003
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only this NV CPU PCIe Bad TLP correctable row
new_technical_evidence.supports: The correctable Bad TLP label, generic pre/post steps, TBD Criteria and 10/10-minute estimates.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: All executable, topology and acceptance details are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Separates traffic endpoint/origin, receiver and AER reporting Root Port/RCEC.
Does not equate Bad TLP with a particular Bad LCRC stimulus.
Makes BERT/BMC evidence conditional on the platform recipe.
Defines correctable health as no unexpected reset/retrain/function loss, subject to the signed platform rule.
remaining_blockers: Criteria, executable procedure, platform/topology, Bad TLP generator, locus map, coverage, event/counter rule, timeout, approvals and recovery are unresolved; the test remains BLOCKED.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains the correct BLOCKED decision but prevents wrong-device and wrong-reporting-port plans, removes universal BERT/SEL assumptions and adds the correctable no-reset/link-function evidence gate.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The contract-only validator kept endpoint/origin, receiver and Root Port/RCEC reporting locus distinct; rejected Bad LCRC substitution, inferred BDFs and generic tools; and correctly limited current work to read-only discovery. It identified document and platform-handoff defects and made no execution or PASS claim.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Reliability row 106 supplies only a PCIe Bad TLP correctable label and leaves Criteria as TBD.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly blocks injection but does not fully distinguish the endpoint/origin, receiver and AER reporting port or make BERT/SEL conditional.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow non-mutating topology/AER ownership/counter/health inventory only; no clearing, configuration or stimulus until exact loci, generator, evidence, approvals and recovery pass fresh review.
